title: Amazon's new Texas AI data center will include massive amounts of air pollution
content_html:
In 2019, Amazon signed the Climate Pledge, aiming to help Earth's environmental health. In 2026, Amazon aims to set a record for the most air pollution emitted by a single power plant.

The New York Times reported that the company is building a new natural-gas-burning power plant in Pecos County, Texas, for a huge AI data center project. The plant, if built as planned, would emit approximately 33 million tons of carbon dioxide into the atmosphere annually, making it among the largest emitters in the United States.

AI data centers are already known to have multiple huge downsides to their construction. Aside from their huge carbon emissions, they're also known for generating massive amounts of noise pollution, and they can raise utility bills for nearby residents if they use the local electrical grid. Amazon's new plant won't necessarily do the last thing, as it's providing its own power using natural gas, but the proposed carbon emissions would still be damaging to the environment.

Construction of the plant appears to be proceeding despite recent pushback from the Texas government on data centers. As for Amazon's Climate Pledge, a spokesperson told the NYT that, simply put, things change over time.

"The world looks different now than when we co-founded the climate pledge," the spokesperson told the New York Times.

content_html_zh:
2019年，亚马逊签署了气候承诺，旨在帮助地球的环境健康。 亚马逊的目标是到 2026 年创下单一发电厂空气污染排放量最多的记录。

《纽约时报》报道称，该公司正在德克萨斯州佩科斯县建造一座新的天然气燃烧发电厂，用于一个庞大的人工智能数据中心项目。 如果按计划建成，该工厂每年将向大气排放约 3300 万吨二氧化碳，使其成为美国最大的排放国之一。

众所周知，人工智能数据中心的建设存在多个巨大的缺点。 除了巨大的碳排放之外，它们还因产生大量噪音污染而闻名，如果附近居民使用当地电网，它们可能会提高水电费。 亚马逊的新工厂不一定会做最后一件事，因为它使用天然气提供自己的电力，但拟议的碳排放仍然会对环境造成破坏。

尽管德克萨斯州政府最近对数据中心提出了反对，但该工厂的建设似乎仍在继续。 至于亚马逊的气候承诺，一位发言人告诉《纽约时报》，简单地说，事情会随着时间而改变。

这位发言人告诉《纽约时报》：“现在的世界与我们共同制定气候承诺时有所不同。”
